title: Trip Trap
overview: The Armstrong Family - Ian (Whately), Kate (Gonet) and their children Tom and Molly live in a nice country house. But beneath this seemingly normal exterior, Maggie begins to suffer violent abuse at the hands of the normally placid Ian, with dreadful consequences for all the family.

file.itemTitle: Ayahuasca Trip: Enki Returns: Helper or AI Trap?
